liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and total liquidity stood at {{liquidity@FY2025}}, including {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} of undrawn committed facilities.

The EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, still far above the airport peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}.

In FY2024 the Spanish network carried {{passengers@FY2024}} passengers, with traffic growth of {{traffic_growth@FY2024}} and aeronautical revenue per passenger of {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}}.
The regulator set the average airport charge per passenger for 2026 above the prior year's level, which supports the aeronautical revenue base.
